cd /workspace/tmp && timeout 900 python3 - <<'EOF'
import random, sys, time, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
import pipeline
random.seed(5)
entries=[]; seen=set()
while len(entries)<2048:
    a=random.getrandbits(128)
    if a in seen: continue
    seen.add(a); entries.append((a,128,random.randrange(65536)))
fib=[{'prefix':pipeline.canonical_prefix(a,l),'hop':h} for a,l,h in entries]
req={'op':'compile','fib':fib,'capacities':[10**9]*16,'max_stride':32}
t=time.time(); img=pipeline.do_compile(req); print('compile %.2f' % (time.time()-t), img['cuts'])
addrs=[pipeline.canonical_addr(random.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(20000)]
lreq={'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':addrs}
t=time.time(); res=pipeline.do_lookup(lreq); print('lookup %.2f' % (time.time()-t), res['status'], res['answers'][:2])
print('request json size', len(json.dumps(lreq)))
EOF
